title: Llama
svg:

    <ellipse cx='77' cy='30' rx='1.8' ry='1.4' fill='#8a6a4a'/>

    <path d='M74 34 Q76 36 78 34' stroke='#8a6a4a' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
